traits.name: Toxin System
traits.description: Has a toxin resource pool that regenerates and can be injected via bite.

traits.name: Scent Tracking
traits.description: Enhanced hunt via scent with 100% success rate.

traits.name: Scent Track Flavor
traits.description: Custom flavor text for the hunt command scent message.

traits.name: Breath Damage Bonus
traits.description: Percentage bonus to breath-type spell damage.

traits.name: Sunlight Vulnerability
traits.description: Takes damage when outdoors during daytime.

traits.name: Blood Feeding
traits.description: Gains nourishment from blood and biting rather than normal food.

traits.name: Bash Damage Multiplier
traits.description: Multiplier applied to bash damage.

traits.name: Holy Damage Bonus
traits.description: Percentage bonus to melee damage against evil-aligned targets.

traits.name: Stakeable
traits.description: Can be staked while sleeping.

traits.name: Can Shapeshift
traits.description: Has access to the shift command for alternate combat forms.

traits.name: Shift Form
traits.description: Name of the alternate form when shapeshifting.

traits.name: Mana Regen Multiplier
traits.description: Multiplier applied to mana regeneration rate.

traits.name: Ranged Accuracy Bonus
traits.description: Flat percentage bonus to ranged weapon accuracy.

traits.name: Death Plane VNUM Min
traits.description: Minimum vnum of alternate death room range. 0 means use default death room.

traits.name: Death Plane VNUM Max
traits.description: Maximum vnum of alternate death room range. 0 means use default death room.

traits.name: Cosmic Projection
traits.description: Can project between planes of existence.

traits.name: Classless Skills
traits.description: Can learn skills from any class rather than only their own.

traits.name: Uses Mana
traits.description: Class is mana-focused and gains full mana regen per level.

traits.name: HP Gain Min
traits.description: Minimum HP gained per level from class (before CON bonus).

traits.name: HP Gain Max
traits.description: Maximum HP gained per level from class (before CON bonus).

traits.name: Primary Stat
traits.description: Primary attribute index for the class (STAT_STR=0, STAT_INT=1, STAT_WIS=2, STAT_DEX=3, STAT_CON=4).

traits.name: Nature Regen
traits.description: Gains 33% bonus HP/mana/move regen while in natural terrain, and small HP/move ticks while moving through nature.

traits.name: Exotic Weapon Mastery
traits.description: Gains 25% bonus melee damage when wielding an exotic weapon.

traits.name: Mounted Combat
traits.description: Mount can enter combat while being ridden (normally mounts cannot fight).

traits.name: Backstab Multiplier
traits.description: Damage multiplier applied to backstab attacks.

traits.name: Blackjack Mastery
traits.description: Gets improved blackjack chance (3x/2) instead of reduced (1/2).

traits.name: Lockpick Mastery
traits.description: Automatically succeeds at lock picking without a skill check.

traits.name: Stealth Combat
traits.description: Sneaking is not broken when dealing damage in combat.

traits.name: Sword and Dagger Parry
traits.description: Gets improved parry when dual-wielding a sword and dagger combination.

traits.name: Backstab Followup
traits.description: Can perform a bonus slice attack after a successful backstab when wielding sword and dagger.

traits.name: Slit Throat Mastery
traits.description: Gets 50% improved slit throat chance.

traits.name: Extra Attack Chance
traits.description: Gets improved fourth attack chance (skill/2 instead of skill/3).

traits.name: Enhanced Parry
traits.description: Gets 50% improved parry chance.

traits.name: Divine Healer
traits.description: Cure spells use full skill proficiency instead of a flat 75% chance.

traits.name: Potion Recharge
traits.description: Can recharge magical potions using the brew skill.
